- Chat: the weather goes to the model or the web when either is on (it came back as the app's own "not something this app knows"), and a local web search carries the city of your timezone. The no-model badge's help no longer nudges the bubble 2px taller on hover.
- Reminders from where they are said: a reminder's menu has Add to Google Calendar and Add to Outlook (the add-event page filled in, opened only when pressed, a private note's words never in it, beside the .ics whose events all carry an alert), a selection in a note makes a reminder linked to that note, and a chat message like "I need to call the dentist on Friday" gets a Make this a reminder chip under the reply (rules only, nothing made until pressed; no chip for a question or something already done).
- Whiteboard: each stroke stacks (the owner, 2026-10-27). A pen or highlighter stroke, shape or line sits over or under a card by its order like any other item: Bring forward, Send back, to front and to back move it past cards (a mixed selection too), a new stroke lands on top and is drawn over the cards while it is drawn, the Layers tab lists cards and drawings in one order, and the export draws the same order. Boards made before keep their look: their drawings move under their lowest card once, order kept (saved and built-in stencils too). A duplicated board keeps each stroke's place (strokes were copied at z 0), and a shape or link the assistant draws lands on top. Layer-order pair sweep, 45 pairs: expectation misses 41 to 0, painted vs model 0 of 450. 300 strokes and 60 cards in 60 bands, A/B in one session (5 runs each): main-thread time per frame panning 4.21 to 3.94 ms, drawing 2.83 to 2.51 ms; frame interval 16.67 ms both.
- Docs pass: the README's test count (12,400+, badge and command), the architecture notes' tool count (72, with the five tools the list had missed: `search_help`, `calculate`, `check_answer`, `propose_act`, `move_notes`) and test and file counts, and the contributing guides' test count now match the tree.
- Seasons follow your hemisphere. "Summer", "last winter" and "summer 2025" now mean December to February in en-AU, en-NZ, en-ZA and the other southern locales, and June to August elsewhere (they were always northern). Settings, General, Seasons picks automatic (your language and region), northern or southern; a season with a year starts in that year. Tested on the fixed clock in `tests/test_season_hemisphere_1027.py`.
- Search by meaning downloads only after a yes. It used to fetch about 2 GB (the package from PyPI, the model from huggingface.co) on the first saved note, unasked. Now the first save offers it once in a notice (Download or No thanks) and keeps the answer; Settings, Search and index has Download search by meaning to change it later. Search uses keywords meanwhile with no error. `TESSELLATE_NO_AUTO_INSTALL` still stops it for good, and the outbound-network test no longer needs it.
- The name stands alone: "Tessellate", without "notes", centred over the tagline on the Windows splash, the desktop loading window, the boot splash, About, the README and the website. The boot splash and loading window now stack the mark over the name (the name's centre was 71px right of the mark's in the boot splash; now 0).
- The composer's cold import is 15% lighter (0.117 to 0.099 s here): the two largest patterns compile on first use, so 3.13 CI is back under its 0.2 s budget.
- Timeline calendar: a month taller than its pane (at 1280 by 800, 729px in 579) fades the pane's bottom edge while rows wait below the fold, and the shortcuts sheet, Settings keys list and the Guide now say that a formatting toolbar is one Tab stop with Left and Right between its buttons.
- OCR workspace: switching files and pages is fast, a page no longer waits for a reader, and the boxes no longer blink. The page label and the lit page in the rail move at the click (they waited for the regions answer, which waited for the server's one PDF lock behind 24 full-size rail renders), the page count comes from the header read instead of the reader, the rail draws quarter-width thumbnails, and a stale page's answer is cancelled and cannot paint over the next. The server keeps the pages it drew, no longer recompresses them (340 of a 456 ms page), and a whole-document read lets the lock go between pages. On a 24-page PDF in the browser: click to page label 492 to 3133 ms down to 10 to 35 ms (3493 to 6941 ms down to 10 to 21 ms with a reader that takes 3 s a page); file switch to label 904 to 3378 ms down to 10 to 164 ms; a first view of a page 150 to 300 ms; a viewer page behind a whole-document read waited 4223 ms, now 222 ms. Boxes and live words across three reloads of an unchanged page: 36 and 144 removed and re-added, now 0 and 0.
- Chat (composer classes, round 6): a date phrase reads the same with "last year", "this year" or "next year" as with a year number, and with "since", "before", "until", "till" or "after" in front: a day ("20 March this year", "March 20th last year"), a season ("summer last year", "winter of 2025"), a part of a month or year ("early March last year", "early next year", "the second half of last year"), a range ("between 1 and 10 March this year", "from March to May last year") and "since last spring" are each one window for lists, counts, search and filters, not a month plus a stray "last year". Seasons stay northern, and "winter this year" is the winter that starts in this year (an owner decision on both is pending).
- Graph: the clean-up that pushes notes off lines is cheaper on big maps: the notes are filed in a grid too, a line's curve is built once and kept while the pushes run, and the step-off goes to the notes least into a line first and goes round again while there is time. At 400 notes, median in the browser: notes on a line 132 to 115 at 390 wide (117 to 118 at 1440), crossings 1662 to 1616 (1566 to 1573), the map rests in 9.2 s against 9.6 at 390 and 9.4 against 9.3 at 1440; at 186 notes 19 on a line both ways, crossings 385 to 393, 5.9 s against 6.0. Most spots a stuck note could move to are on another line (95%), so the last 115 notes need more than time.
- Chat (composer classes, INBOX 1026e): a list of notes by date leaves archived notes out like a count does unless the question says archived ("notes from 24 to 30 September", "what did I write last week"); a month with "last year", "this year" or "next year" is that month of that year ("November last year", "June of last year", "March this year", "May next year", which has no notes yet). A note that is one label line ("Blockers: none.") is listed as Untitled with its line, and a headed note no longer repeats its title in the line.
- Graph: the clean-up that pushes notes off the lines they stand on now runs on maps of more than 100 notes, too (it was skipped for its cost, so about 45 of 186 notes stayed on a line). The lines are filed in a grid, so a note is checked against the few lines near it, not all of them. At 186 notes, median of 3 in the browser: notes on a line 45 to 19 at 1440 and 52 to 23 at 390; the map rests in 6.8 s against 7.1 (1440) and 5.8 against 5.7 (390); crossings 353 to 385 and 323 to 339. At 400 notes: 165 to 118 and 179 to 134 on a line, the map rests in 10.1 s against 9.7 (1440) and 11.3 against 9.8 (390).
- Graph: each Options section's ? button sits at the end of its heading, after the arrow, and pressing it opens the help without opening or closing the section.
- Chat (composer classes, INBOX 1026d): archived notes are in no count unless asked for ("how many notes do I have", a month, a folder, a tag); "how many work notes" with no such tag or folder counts the notes that mention the word and says so; a run of days in one month ("24-30 September", "from 24 to 30 September", "between the 3rd and the 9th of May", "September 24 to 30"), a season or month with a year and no lead word ("winter 2025", "summer 2024 notes", "March 2026 notes") are read as dates; a note that is one short label line ("Blockers: none.") is listed by its date.
- Graph: the untangle runs up to three passes (two past 100 notes) and gives each pass time by the size of the map (200 ms to 36 notes, 372 ms at 186), and the notes the passes leave on a line are pushed off it once, at the end, so none stands on one at 36 notes at 1440 wide (was 10, in the browser). At rest in the browser, median of 3: 36 notes 62 to 53 crossings at 1440 and 53 to 51 at 390; 186 notes 372 to 353 and 355 to 323; the map rests in 4.1 s at 36 notes (was 3.8) and 7.2 s at 186 (was 6.8). The similarity slider is now "Match strength" under Size, shown while Similarity is on, not inside the closed Show fold.
- Whiteboard tables: Widen this column, Narrow this column and Equal column widths in the table menu (a quarter wider or a fifth narrower at the pressed cell, the others give way, the table keeps its width); the grid, the export, Add and Delete a column and Undo follow; a table made before is unchanged. Measured: first column 137.7px against 110.1px, 358px in all, export within 1px.
- Whiteboard export: a sticky draws its folded corner (the board colour cut away and the darker fold, read off the board) and a picture with rounded corners is clipped to them, in SVG, PNG and PDF; the corner pixels read the paper and red before, now the board colour and the fold.
- Whiteboard: Mermaid, draw.io, the Join command, Place joined and a dragged link, and every library placement now land on top of what is already on the board (drawings over drawings, cards over cards, frames under frames) instead of at a fixed z; 16 of 16 overlapped pairs came in under before, 0 now.
- Whiteboard: a canvas shown with no pointer event since no longer reads 16px left and 60px high (the paste chip, drops and pastes at any zoom or pan; 20 of 20 measured points off, now 0), because its cached origin is dropped when the canvas resizes and the chip reads it fresh.
- Composer: the heading and picture-line readers no longer backtrack over long runs of tabs (CodeQL, 4 alerts).
- Time words: seasons ("last summer", "in winter", "over the winter": June to August, December to February) and a week or half of a named month ("the first week of October", "the last week of September", "the second half of March") are read as dates, and "anything from September" asks what was written, not what is coming.
- Chat: a window said twice in one question ("what did I write this week, I mean this week") is the same window, taken out once.
- Chat (composer classes, INBOX 1026c): counts by state are exact ("how many pinned notes", "archived notes", "checklists", "open tasks" or "unticked items", "reminders", "reminders this week"), and "count my work notes" counts the tag or folder.
- Graph: the untangle runs two passes with the relax between, and the relax cools several ticks a frame, so the map rests about 2.5 s sooner at 36 notes (`end` 3.8 s after the layout starts, was 6.3) and 186 notes lose 5 to 9% of their crossings in the browser (722 to 683 at 1440, 677 to 617 at 390).
- Graph: a toast over the map stands above the legend and left of the zoom strip, so it covers neither (0 intersections at 1440, 1024, 820 and 390; it met the legend row at 1440 and the zoom strip at 390).
- Graph: every Options section (Physics, Show, Display, Filter, Time, Groups, Minimap) has a ? that says in a line what each control does to the map, and with every fold closed the panel fits its box at 1440x900 (520px of list in 520, was 904 in 512): Show and Time are folds like the rest, Trace sits beside Legend and Suggest links beside Reset to defaults, and the cap leaves a gap above the zoom strip.
- Recordings: the waveform is 64px tall (48px on a phone), up from 40px, so the peaks read.
- Documents: a code file prints as monospaced code with line numbers (Ctrl+P and the menu's Print or save as PDF, which is no longer hidden for code), instead of the live editor.
- Code editor: sending the Assistant an empty question puts the cursor in the field, rings it in the error ink and says so under it (the old line landed at the foot of the panel, off screen).
- Documents: a code file's status bar shows lines, characters and the language instead of words and a reading time.
- Time words: "from Monday to Wednesday", "between March and May", "between 1 and 5 October", "recently" and "lately" (the last 14 days, said in the answer) are read as dates, and "this weekend" asked of the past is the weekend just gone.
- Chat (composer classes, INBOX 1357/1400): a board, mind map or document is found by the words on it, not only by name ("tell me about IaaS" answers from the Cloud computing map and says it is a map); a map or an indented list is said as a hierarchy ("Service models: IaaS, PaaS and SaaS"); "tell me more" skips what an earlier answer drew on by where it sits in the note, not by its wording; counts narrowed by link state, tag, category or a window say the filtered number ("7 unlinked notes"), and a tag or category you do not have is said with the nearest one; "how many boards" and "how many maps" count them; a "when" answer leads with the sentence that holds a date.
- Graph: a new Organic layout is untangled once it settles (notes trade places or turn within their category when that lowers the crossings, then glide there), the category ring is ordered by the links between categories, the last of the cooling runs several ticks a frame, and a phone cuts names to 14 characters so more of them fit.
- Stats: counts of nothing are said as "no" ("You are not using any tags yet", "You have no documents"), and one note takes a singular verb ("1 note out of 3 has no tags").
- Chat: a mind-map node or board card written "Label: text" is said as its own text in a summary, never as a bold heading over the rest.
- Time words: "over the weekend", "last fortnight", "since Monday", "the other day", "earlier this week", "so far this month", "year to date" and the rest of the this/last/past N days, weeks, months forms are read as dates in recaps and searches.
- Graph: the gear is a worded Options button at the front of the dock, and the View section (Layout, Shape, Colour, Size) has a ? that says what each one does.
- Graph: the force view is calmer and easier to read. A landscape map is laid out wider (the 36-note seed at 1440x900 fills 0.54 of the width, was 0.49, and names 20 notes, was 10, none overlapping); a note with many links draws its lines straight and faint until you point at it; a note's panel has Open, Focus, Pin and Link as worded buttons with the rest under the ⋯, in place of nine bare icons.
- Code files: the word-count goal button is not offered in a code file.
- Recordings and code files (owner 1400): a recording's menu has Download audio (the file as it was recorded), and Print or save as PDF on a code file says it is for writing instead of printing a blank sheet.
- Code files, downloads (owner 1400): Download as .html of a Python or other code file saved an empty page named without its dot (apppy.html); it now saves the source as preformatted text named app.py.html, and the image bundle, Word export and Map the headings (which have nothing to work on in code) are out of a code file's menu.
- Code files on a phone (owner 1400): the bar at the foot of a code file now holds Tab, Outdent, Undo, Redo and the brackets and common symbols (it held Bold, Italic and Heading), and Ctrl+G goes to a line in a code file.
- Recordings (owner 1400): the library search now finds a recording by what was said in it, shows the matching line with its time and plays from there when pressed; and Transcribe is always in a recording's menu (it was missing until the recorder had run once in a session, and with no add-on it gave no reason) and says what to install.
- Code files (owner 1400, fixed as a class): Ctrl+B, I, E, U, 1 to 3 and the list chords no longer write markdown into a Python, SQL or other code file, and the slash and double-bracket menus no longer open over one (a `//` comment raised Heading 1).
- Chat: a short message whose word only a Guide topic's bracketed or quoted examples hold ("what about running?", "who is Sam") is a missing word in your notes, not a request for an app tool.
- No-model fallbacks for the AI-only buttons (owner-1026b K3, fixed as a class): Suggest a title takes the title from the draft's own words, and Split into notes, Extract notes (document, selection, note review, board cards) and Save notes cut the text at its headings and paragraphs with a preview, linked to the notes it came from; none is greyed out for want of a model, a failed model split falls back to the same cut, and Draft, Refine, Plan, Draft with Atlas and AI edit now answer a press with why and Set up a model instead of doing nothing. A title no longer ends on a word like "about" or "the".
- Whiteboard: one layer order for the whole board. What paints on top is now what a click hits, what Bring to front and Send to back change, what the Layers tab lists and what the export draws (frames, then drawings, then cards; a new item goes on top of its layer). A pair sweep of nine item kinds found 92 disagreements between the board and its own order before, 0 after.
- Documents: a paste whose only formatting is a span's bold or italic style (a lone styled span from a web page or Word online) now arrives as Markdown (**Heavy words**) instead of plain text; a monospace code copy with a bold token still pastes as code.
- Whiteboard and mind map: the canvas no longer scrolls on its own. A new topic's editor took focus and the browser scrolled the box to centre it (Tab under Cells at 1440x900 moved the map 351px with the zoom unchanged); focus now keeps the view and any stray scroll is folded into the zoom, and a new topic slides in by the least move (24px inside the edge) instead of being centred.
- Mind map: the topic bar on a phone no longer ends a row on its divider or leaves the reset alone; the divider goes under 600px and under 380px the bar is three columns (390 wide: one row of five on a root, 4 and 2 on a child; 360: 3 and 2).
- Whiteboard: exporting a board (SVG, PNG, PDF) now draws a text box or sticky as the box it is (paper, border, rounded corners) and a table as its grid and words; both used to come out as bare words or nothing.
- Whiteboard: Enter works from the keyboard alone. With the text, sticky or frame tool held it drops one in the middle of the view, and on a selected text box or sticky it puts the caret at the end of the words (N, Enter, type no longer needs a click).
- Whiteboard: Find and Replace all now read a table's cells; a table holding the word used to report no matches.
- Whiteboard: words typed into a shape that do not fit now make the shape bigger in proportion, as one undo step with the words; before, 80 characters ran 100px past a 100x60 rectangle and across its border (diamonds and ellipses too).
- Whiteboard: a text box or sticky grows taller as you type, so long text is never hidden behind a scroll bar inside the card (a 177px paragraph sat in a 62px box); Grow to fit the words uses the same measure, and one undo takes back the words and the growth together.
- Whiteboard: undoing a paste (or any change that removes what is selected) no longer leaves a ghost selection; Export > Selection used to fail with a 'width' error and write nothing.
- Board text: the Format panel's Bold and Italic wrap the words you selected, not the first place those words occur, work on text typed but not yet saved, and a second press takes the marks off again.
- A new mind map from a template that is too wide to read on a phone now opens at full size on its centre topic instead of shrunk to 17% (the New board dialog fitted it again after it had framed itself).
- Mind map: the topic Shape menu showed only seven of its nine boxes (Cloud and Plain sat past the menu's edge, unreachable); a long row of choices is now a grid, six to a row, and Chevron and Underline are in it. A test holds the API, the menu, the pickers, the glyphs and the stylesheet to one list of shapes.
- Mind map templates build what their pictures show: Career plan is a root box over four chevron topics each with two underlined bars, laid out Tree, downward as named (a new map from a template was a sideways ladder under that name). Every template stores its centre's shape and each topic's shape (Chevron and Underline are new in the topic Box picker), and the picture is drawn from the same data. Checked on all 27 templates at 1440: layout, branch and leaf shapes and counts match, 0 overlaps.
- Documents: a new document you typed in and then emptied again is removed when you switch to another tab, as it already was on New or opening another document, so the list does not collect empty "Untitled document" rows.
- Documents: pasting a screenshot or dropping a picture into a document now uploads it and writes the image where the caret (paste) or pointer (drop) is; it did nothing before, although the "/" menu said both worked. A copy from a spreadsheet or Word keeps pasting its text, not its picture. Pasting a bulleted or numbered list from Word keeps the list and its levels (it arrived as "· item" lines).
- Documents: Enter on an empty quote line ends the quote (a nested one steps out a level), and Tab on a numbered item renumbers it for its new level ("1." as the first of a nested list, the next number when brought back out) instead of keeping "2." in a list of one.
- Documents: Ctrl+U underlines (it was CodeMirror's "undo selection" and looked dead; a second press takes it off, as does Superscript and Subscript), Ctrl+H opens Replace with the cursor in the Replace field, and hiding the formatting toolbar with Ctrl+Shift+X no longer drops the keyboard onto the page.
- Documents: the heading, list, task and quote buttons switch a line instead of stacking markers (Numbered on a bullet gave "1. - x", H2 on a heading did nothing); a second press takes it off, a numbered list counts 1, 2, 3, blank lines stay blank. Undo and Redo, Outdent and Indent no longer split across a wrapped toolbar row.
- Spelling and grammar no longer mark the words of a link, code, addresses, file paths, email addresses or a unit after a number ("10-20 min" is not "minimum"); Settings, Writing, Check link text turns the link words back on (K11, K4b).
- Grammar: list items, headings and table cells are never judged as long sentences; en dash ranges, the Oxford comma and abbreviation expanders are off; names are no longer misspelt; "your" for "you're" is caught. Fixture: 58 false positives on 77 clean lines became 0, and 33 of 33 planted errors are caught (K4).
- Notes: a long note no longer pushes Save off the screen. The note edit form's box scrolls inside a cap (Save was 29px below a 900px window after 60 lines) and its foot stays pinned; the graph popups' Save and the chat edit boxes follow the same rule.
- Chat and Ask: “what did I do last week” recaps every kind by day, notes, documents, boards, mind maps and reminders made, edited, binned or ticked off, each linked; an empty window says so by name and gives the nearest days with something new.
- Dashboard: with no model, Generate this week's digest composes the week from your notes (what you made, edited and binned, what is overdue and coming, where the notes went) instead of saying no model is connected.
- Chat and Ask with no model: a named board, map or document is read as itself; “show me my boards” and “what maps do I have” list them; “list my categories” names every category with the counts /categories gives; “my oldest note” gives one note; “what's still to do” lists the open checkboxes; “timer” and “set a timer” say how to start the app's timer; “what can you even do” gets the tour; “quantum chromodynamics” is no longer cut to “quantum”; “tomorrow” in an old note is said as its date; IaaS keeps its capitals.
- Chat and Ask with no model: the line after an answer no longer calls the note it cited your newest or latest when it is not (it named the oldest note that way).
- Settings, Models: with no model connected, the status line says Atlas answers with its built-in composer until one is.
- Loading placeholders now take the count and height of what that list drew last time, so the swap no longer jumps (Reminders: 290px to 0px).
- Faster start: the model badge's spec panel, editing a chat answer and a note's Explain row load on first use (1,965 bytes less boot script).
- Settings: Extras no longer jumps when its package list arrives; its placeholders take the list's size.
- Boards: select words in a text box or sticky while typing and the selection bar bolds, italicises, strikes, highlights, codes, links or lists just that part (Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+K too, Ctrl+Z undoes); the box keeps markdown and shows it rendered once you finish.
- Boards: an empty text box or sticky shows its typing caret again.
- Start a timer and Start a stopwatch now show in Tools and features, the shortcuts dialog's Tools list and the "/" menus, not only the command palette.
- Ask: under a model's answer a From your notes line opens the quoted answer to the same question beside it (one fetch, shut and opened again freely, not saved to Ask history), and what the composer says first (the personal digest, a place in the app) is drawn as a card above the AI text instead of being dropped.
- Header: the small "notes" beside the Tessellate name is gone (the owner, 2026-10-26).
- Mind maps: a line style picker beside the Layout picker draws every line on the map Curved, Straight (one segment) or Elbow (right angles, rounded corners); a topic's own line shape still wins, and Ctrl+Z undoes it.
- Mind maps: each end of a line has a grip (point at the line or select a topic): drag it round the topic to pin the side the line leaves or enters, in any layout; it stays there when either topic moves. Double-click it, or the topic menu's Lines, Line ends: back to Auto, to let the layout choose again.
- Mind maps: four more topic shapes for a core idea or any topic: Circle, Hexagon, Diamond and Cloud, the words kept centred inside the shape and the lines meeting its outline.
- Companion: thrown at the top bar it catches hold more often (it mostly bounced off), and on the way down it may catch the end of a panel it falls past, or catch the edge as it slides off one, and pull itself up; each catch hangs a different while before the pull.
- Fix: the companion's face accessories (sunglasses, an eyepatch, a mask) turn and tilt with its face; reading glasses are no longer drawn over glasses it wears; it holds a book in both hands in front of it, and Atlas reads its book of light at its chest rather than sitting on it.
- Fix: the companion looks asleep without its Zs: its head lolls with a slow breathing bob, its eyes shut (they never did, under the blink loop), sunglasses go up onto its forehead, and hanging it holds on by one hand and sways like a sloth.
- Boards and mind maps: right-click a selection for Export selection, Copy as image (PNG, or a download with a note where the browser cannot copy pictures) and Copy as SVG; a selection export is the selection plus 24px of the canvas ground, with its links.
- Presenter mode: the laser is one steady dot that follows every pointer move (it no longer fades out when the pointer slows), and the page bar's title cell has a fixed width with an ellipsis so the arrows sit at the same place on every page.
- Ask: the Use AI chip is now a compact AI pill switch in the ask input row beside the answer length. It starts neutral (unchecked, enabled) until the first model status, so it never flips from active to disabled; greyed, its hover text and the Ask notice name the cause: Ollama not answering at its URL, answering with no models pulled, or the chosen chat model not installed. Measured with no model: neutral at 0 and 200 ms, disabled with the cause at 1000 and 3000 ms; text contrast 17.07 light, 14.61 dark; on-track 5.90 / 7.33; other controls in the row keep their widths.
- Composer: a topic answer counts the records the search matched, not only the ones filed under it, and says how many are filed ("You have seven notes about academics & tech, all from September; two are filed under it"). Was two for a topic whose Matching records listed more.
- Ollama on localhost is asked on 127.0.0.1, so a running Ollama on Windows no longer reads as "No model connected" (a refused ::1 outlasted the 1 s connect wait).
- Composer: a dated note that opens on its own day says the day once, and its later sentences and weekdays are told as of that day ("you had work", "due that Friday").
- Notes > Ask: the asked question stays in the box, selected, after any ask (typed, a chip, a follow-up, Retry or History); the search-mode badge is the standard label chip, link chips no longer clip descenders, and the why-matched line is a quiet muted sentence with its icon level with the first line.
- Settings: shortcut keys sit in one column with the pencils lined up, and hover no longer draws a second box behind the keys.
- Discoverability: one registry of popup tools (Equation, Calculator, Convert units) now lists each in the Ctrl+K palette, Tools and features, a Tools list in Keyboard shortcuts (Alt+= for Equation), the "/" menus in notes, documents and Chat, and the Guide; Convert units opens the Calculator on its conversion tab.
- Header: the emblem no longer claims the AI is running when it is not.
- Board: the arrows and turn handle hide while a size or gap badge shows, so the numbers are no longer covered.
- Fix: the default board now gets a stored thumbnail on the Boards list like every other board (its missing id was skipped by the thumbnail writer; it travels as board 0).
- Fix: resizing a note card now moves its four arrows and its links with the box on every frame, as a text box or picture already did (the right arrow was 98px inside the box at +120, now 22px outside at every step).
- Fix: the companion lies down only where its whole body fits on its perch, head left or right to suit (it lay with only its legs on the board's tool dock); its shadow and dark-theme glow sit under the lying body, its Zs rise over its head, the hair above a hat's brim or the nightcap's band is hidden, and no nightcap goes over a hat it already wears.
- CI: today's lint ratchets back in line (guards on boot functions dropped from the equation editor, one-off sweeps whose findings are in this log removed, the lag view read through prefs, the sketch button no longer hands its click event to openSketch).
- Fix: turning Graph auto-fit back on after a resize with it off now frames the map again, instead of leaving the camera treated as moved for good.
- Fix: the Web row in the palette and the slash menu always toggles web search; the Web button opens the panel first when web is on and the panel is shut, and its tooltip and the Guide say so.
- Fix: leaving a document no longer deletes an older empty "Untitled document N" you made on purpose; only a blank document created in this session and never written in is dropped.
- Fix: a name typed in a note's maths that matches a built-in word (\toString, \begin{constructor}) broke the equation instead of drawing it; an equation that cannot be drawn now shows its source in the editor and the equation dialog.
- Fix: a failed send in the popup agent now also removes the documents it had just imported from attached files, so a retry no longer duplicates them.
- Graph: Unpin all and Reset release document pins too, and their Undo puts back every pin they released, including ones a filter hid.
- Whiteboard: the size readout while drawing or resizing draws its digits in a readable pair; it was black on a dark plate.
- Review fixes: persona voices match whole words and a formal persona reads the professional lines; "my work visa" and "since we added" questions can reach the web again; the topic summary builds its no-AI answer only when it is used; a chat question is capped at 20,000 characters.
- CodeQL: the composer reads "Lisbon notes" as Lisbon by word steps, not a regex quadratic on a run of whitespace.
- Settings > Help has a Show Get started button, for bringing back the dashboard's Get started after hiding it.
- Fix: the Windows splash drew "Tessellate notes" with colour fringes and "notes" run into the name. The wordmark is now greyscale-smoothed with a proper gap.
- Fix: a picture pasted on a board drew at its own size inside a smaller selection box, and dragging a grip changed the box but not the picture. A picture now fills its box (aspect kept), so the box, grips and resize match. The size badge no longer sits under the grip being dragged, reads on its plate, and appears only for the item being resized.
- New: double-click a resize grip to fit a picture to its own shape, and a note or text box to its content, as one Undo step (the grip tooltip and the Guide say so).
- Fix: asking "what did I do last week?" with web search on and no model went to the web (and reported the search service down). Questions about your own doings never go to the web now.
- Fix: the ... button on Library image tiles was a faint glyph on the photo. It now sits on a small solid chip that reads on any picture.
- Fix: the rows of "How this map looks" sat flush against each other; they now have the dialog's gap, every select is one width, and the switches' words match the labels.
- Fix: in a mind map that grows down, a topic dragged level with its parent joined it bottom to top, doubling back. It now joins side to side.
- Attachments: one modern chip (file-type icon or thumbnail, name that keeps its extension, kind and size, an upload bar, a labelled x) now serves Chat's images, documents and files and the popup agent. The popup agent holds files as chips with a paperclip, drop or paste, takes any file kind (not only images and PDFs), and saves nothing until you send, so removing a chip leaves nothing behind. A notice about an added PDF now opens Library > Files, not Images.
- Ask: the Use AI switch is now the Chat dock's toggle chip (lit when on, muted when off) and is drawn from the model status from the first frame, disabled with the reason in its tooltip when no model answers. Measured with no model: off and disabled at 300 ms, 92x32 at 1440, 92x44 at 720, 160x44 at 390, no page overflow.
- Graph: Reset to defaults also releases every pinned note, and the toast's Undo puts the settings and the pins back. Unpin all is now in the graph's ... menu too, and undoable.
- Graph: Shift and drag on empty map draws a box (a straight drag used to catch nothing), and the selection bar has Pin and Unpin for the selected notes (Force layout, one Undo step).
- Fix: the graph's Arc layout fits its real arcs. The fit reserved a third of the line's length above the baseline whatever the arcs did; it now reserves the widest arc's actual rise, so the free space above the top arc and below the labels is 230 and 226 px at 1440x900 (was 250 and 207).
- The graph topic card's Summarise works with no model: the composer writes it from the shared terms, the date span and the two most-linked notes' opening lines, labelled "Summary (no AI)". With a model, the model writes it.
- Equation editor: type /equation in a note, a document, a board's text or the Chat box, pick Equation from a document's Insert menu, or press Alt+= there and in the Ask box. Type it plainly (a/b becomes a fraction, ^ and _ open a power or subscript, alpha, pi, sqrt and sin become symbols after a space, >= and -> one sign; Tab moves to the next box or out of one, Backspace undoes a change), or pick from a palette of Greek, operators, relations, arrows, sets, calculus and structures (root, sum, integral, limit, matrix, cases), with a live preview. It writes TeX between dollar signs; with the cursor in an equation it opens to edit it. The maths renderer now draws matrices, cases, binomials, accents and TeX spaces.
- Fix: the dashboard subtext showed the same pattern every day. It now shows a different one each day.
- Fix: with Web on in Chat, opening the web panel took turning Web off and on again. A click on Web while it is on and the panel is shut now opens the panel; a click with the panel open turns Web off.
- Lag log: the app now notices its own slow moments and writes down what caused them. A frame that blocked the page for 200 ms or more (with the scripts and functions that ran in it, and any forced layout), a click or key that took 300 ms to answer (which control, and whether the time went waiting, running or drawing) and a request that took 3 s, each with the view on screen, the last thing pressed, the page size and memory. They show in Settings > Logs as "Lag:" lines and are kept in lag.log in the logs folder (Settings > Maintenance > Open logs folder), so they survive a restart and can be sent as a file.
- Fix: the graph stats chip says "no links yet" when notes exist but none are joined, and its tooltip says how to link two (open a note's link button, or select two nodes and press Link). Not measured in a browser (Chromium crashed under memory pressure).
- Fix: a keyword hit says "matched your words" and only adds "similar meaning" when its vector is close (cosine 0.6); a long chat title ends in an ellipsis instead of being cut mid-letter (display block, 747px of text in 352); Send on an empty chat box says "Type a message first." and focuses it; a 200-character unbroken note heading wraps instead of being clipped at 720; the Library Create descriptions wrap (5 of 7 were cut at 390); the dashboard greeting no longer reserves two lines at 390 (hero text 117 to 60px, boot layout shift still 0).
- Fix: notes rail and the Forgotten panel no longer say "Forgotten" about a note written minutes ago (it takes three days), and the rail drops its "0 links" chip when nothing is joined. A sketch note reads once in the Library ("Sketch 26 Oct", not "Sketch 26 Oct · Sketch 26 Oct"), loses the 33px blank gap above its picture in the Notes list (card 220 to 197px), keeps its remove-picture cross hidden until the picture is hovered or focused, and shows words not raw `![...` under Most used.
- Fix: a no-model chat answer no longer counts every search hit as its source ("Sources: 4 notes" under "your only note" now lists the notes the answer quoted); a history question such as "when did the estates general meet" is no longer read as a statistics question ("estates" was spelt into "stats"); the closing line quotes a small-typed note title with a capital first letter.
- Fix: with no model, a text note was filed under Sketches at 52-54% because a caption plus a drawing counted as an example for filing by meaning. Picture notes (a short note ending in an image) no longer vote; the note stays Uncategorised with no percentage (measured on a fresh notebook: 52% to 0%).
- Documents Edit view: list bullets and numbers sit beside their words (a bullet was drawn 24 px left of its box, 40 px from the text and half outside the page at 720 px wide; it inherited the line's hanging indent).
- Documents: a new document made by typing takes the name you are typing instead of "Untitled document N", and a document still unnamed and empty when you leave it is moved to the bin instead of piling up in the list. A document with any text stays.
- Documents Read view: a table is set in the body font and sized to its content (three short columns measured 658 px wide in monospace at 1440, now 302 px), and its caption reads "table, header and 3 rows" so the count is not mistaken for the whole table.
- Library: a document card's preview reads a table as its words ("REM, 25%") and drops the `| --- |` rule, bold markers and link syntax.
- Documents: typing "/table" and Enter inserts Table, not Table of contents (a label equal to the query ranks above a longer one that starts with it).
- Documents: typing a pipe table line by line no longer adds empty rows or parks the next line inside a cell (Enter at the end of a typed row is a plain newline). Ctrl+Enter leaves a table below in Live and Source, and Enter on an empty last row removes it and leaves, with a blank line kept between the table and the text.
- Documents export: a .md download no longer repeats an H1 that is already the title, and .md, .zip, .docx and .html share one file name rule (Sleep-essay.docx).
- Board and mind map on a phone and at 720: the new-map template offer no longer runs under the first tile's rail or (at 390) 35px under the selected topic's bar; the Edit, View, Board and Library buttons keep their words as their names when the words are hidden (they were named by their tooltips); the tools sheet's sections share one left edge with no divider hairline; the tools opener says "Select", not "Select (V)"; renaming a board no longer makes the header drop 5px.
- Fix: pressing Ask after typing a question sometimes did nothing. While the field had focus it took the whole row and pushed Ask down; the press moved focus away, the row shrank, and Ask moved 65px up before the click finished. The field keeps the same width focused or not.
- Documents: right-click in the editor opens its own menu: Cut, Copy, Paste, the eight Paste special modes, Turn into and Select all (a hold on a phone). A flagged word still opens its suggestions, a table its row and column menu, and Shift+right-click keeps the browser's menu with its spelling suggestions. A blocked clipboard read says to press Ctrl+V; Paste is one undo step. Escape returns the focus to the text (docpaste.js: 13 rows, 44 px rows at 720 and 390, 0 console errors).
- Documents: an equation can carry a number. `\tag{3}` inside display maths is set at the right edge as (3), and the Read view draws a thin progress line at the top of the page that fills as you scroll (0, 0.5, 1 at the top, middle and end at 1440, 720 and 390).
- Documents: Turn into (Notion's block menu). The swap button on the selection bar, the phone formatting bar's new button and the Ctrl+K row open a menu that turns the block at the caret, or every line selected, into a paragraph, heading 1 to 3, bulleted, numbered or to-do list, quote, callout or code block, taking the old marker off first and as one undo step (docpaste.js at 1440, 720, 390, light and dark: 10 rows, 8 conversions correct, one Ctrl+Z restores, a caret inside a code fence is refused).
- Board: the Format panel's Style tab gains Shadow offset (across, down, blur; setting one turns the shadow on), and for a text box, picture or table four Corner radii (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), and for a text box Padding. They are saved on the item (`shadow_x`, `shadow_y`, `shadow_blur`, `radii`, `pad`; a shape's and a line's shadow too), undo one row at a time, travel with Copy style and Paste style and Reset style, and the SVG export draws the shadow's offset and blur and the padding. The one fixed shadow (0, 2, 4) is the default. wb1005-format.js 17/17 to 24/24 at 1440 and 390; the panel stays inside the view with no sideways scroll at 1440x900, 720x900, 390x844 and 720x500.
- Board: a selected item low on the screen no longer has its lower grips under the zoom pill or the tool row. - Composer: the rest of small talk (insult, emotion, who are you, what can you do, joke, unclear, test) and the nothing-found lines are composed in the chat's voice and persona, 16 or more lines a voice, and the empty-window "Next up" line follows the voice too. Paste special in the Edit menu and Ctrl+K, Paste into the selected shape's text, and Paste without comments (copied items lose their threads). After a paste that changed form (a web page or Word copy turned to Markdown, several lines, a spreadsheet's rows, a web address) a Paste options chip appears at the caret: press Ctrl, then a letter or the arrows, to keep the formatting, take text only, or read it as a table, checklist, quote or code block; one Ctrl+Z undoes the choice. Paste special (document menu and palette) pastes as plain text, Markdown source, code block (language guessed), quote, table from TSV or CSV, link or checklist, and works without clipboard permission by applying to your next Ctrl+V. - Composer: small talk (how are you, sorry, laughter, reactions, confusion, acknowledgements, compliments) is built from a head and a tail in the chat's voice (persona included) and the emotion read from the message, 16 or more distinct lines a voice, instead of one stored line; the no-repeat and shape rules still hold.
- Composer: a definition no longer volunteers unticked checklist items in its Also line; "what's my next exam" and "exam date" answer from the reminder; quiz feedback (right, close, wrong, skipped) is composed in the chosen voice and mood instead of picked from a list.

- Security: the LAN certificate folder and the authority's private key are made private again (0700, 0600) at every start, not only when first made.
- Security: wrong-password waits key an IPv6 device by its /64 network, so a device on the Wi-Fi cannot dodge them by making up new addresses.
- Security: a phone can no longer set where backups are copied on the computer (a UNC path there sent the owner's Windows sign-in over SMB) or switch on beta updates; Settings dims both rows on another device.
- Security: the rebinding guard accepts only the configured `TESSELLATE_LOCAL_NAME` `.localhost` name, and only on a request that arrived on this computer's loopback, never any other `*.localhost` name or one from the network; that name now counts as this computer for sign-in-off and the PIN.

- A friendly local address: set `TESSELLATE_LOCAL_NAME=tessellate` and the launcher, window and tray open `http://tessellate.localhost:8000` instead of localhost. Browsers resolve `*.localhost` to this computer themselves, so it needs no DNS or admin rights; the rebinding guard accepts any `*.localhost` name.

- Whiteboard, from draw.io: Ctrl+Shift and the arrows resize what is selected (right and down grow, left and up shrink, a grid cell with snap on, else 10), and Flip left to right and Flip top to bottom are in the Arrange menu, the right-click menu and the palette, with Shift+H and Shift+V (they were only in the Format panel).
- Whiteboard: switching between the Fill and Border tabs of the colour popup keeps the popup where it is (it jumped 310px, or to the top left when the other colour's well was hidden, as for "Fill for new shapes" with a shape selected).
- Whiteboard: Group and Ungroup are never offered together: one group selected offers Ungroup, anything else of two or more offers Group (merging what is grouped), on the selection bar, the Arrange menu, the right-click menu and the command palette alike.
- Whiteboard: a line given an End mark stays a line in the Format panel, so its Start and End rows stay and setting End back to None makes it a plain line again; the selection bar hides the size of an end with no mark (a line's bar 913 to 700px wide at 1440), and a bar that wraps at half width takes panel corners with no divider at the start of a row (three rows to two at 720).
- Whiteboard: double-clicking a turned frame's rotate grip stands up what it holds as well as the frame, in one Undo step (Ctrl stands up the frame alone).
- Whiteboard: an emoji sticker grows with its box while you resize it (it stayed at its old size, 46px in a 214px box), and a shape's selection box, grips and rotate handle follow a resize live with the "W x H" size beside them, as a box's do.
- With no model, a composed answer ends with a line pointing at what to do next from your newest note ("I can see you've been working on ..."), worded differently from chat to chat; the dock's Length picker now applies to it (Quick keeps the first line only); a persona changes nothing without a model, and Help says so.
- Web reader: Analyse this page lists the page's key points (its own sentences), marks its key terms in the text and lists its sections as links to their headings, with no model and nothing sent out; the reader's typography moved to a lazy stylesheet.
- Reminders: Magic add reads hedged and conditional phrasings ("remind me to do my tax return when I get home tonight, probably around 7pm" is "Do my tax return" at 19:00), including a day part with a clock apart from it ("this evening, 6:30"); the edit form's time field and selects are now one height with no stray margin.
- With no model, "Read <link> and tell me about it" fetches the page and tells back its main points, key terms and sections (when web search is on), or says web access is off with a button to its setting, instead of searching your notes for the link's words; a web search that cannot run (SearXNG not answering) now names the service and links Settings, Web search.
- With no model, an open request ("do smth cool", "open a note") now asks what you meant and offers choices to press (your newest notes, things worth trying), and an instruction the app does not understand is matched to the closest actions it has (by shared words, and by meaning when the embedder runs) instead of searching your notes for its words.
- Ask with a note open answers about that note: "What's left to do?", "When is the deadline?" and "Who is involved?" give the open note's own open tasks, dated sentences or names in a line or two, different for every note, instead of one notebook-wide reply; "Summarise this" names the note instead of "untitled".
- Toasts on the Graph tab stay on the bottom edge and sit left of the zoom strip, instead of being lifted halfway up the screen.

## [0.6.1] - 2026-10-22
- The system tray icon now appears when Tessellate is started from `start.bat` / `start-desktop.bat`: the launcher installed the window (`pywebview`) but not `pystray` and `Pillow`, so the tray, and with it Open and Quit, silently never started on a source install. Both are now installed with the window; if they cannot be, the launcher says so.
- The Guide panel closes when you press outside it (it stays open for presses in its own menus, '?' popovers and dialogs, and on its opener).
- The Skills list: rows no longer wrap and touch. "(edits notes)" is a group heading (Yours or Built-in, read only or edits notes) instead of a suffix on every name, and option rows have one minimum height.
- Whiteboard: a drag on the board (marquee, move, resize) no longer selects text on cards, labels and panels; text being edited keeps its selection.
- Reminders: the edit form's time, priority, repeat and alert fields share one height with a gap between them, and wrap.
- CI: `test_dialogue_b8` no longer depends on the day's date (the older-note line is chosen by the reply's length, which moves with "7 October" against "11 October").
- Windows: the system tray icon is decoded before its thread starts and a failure to start it is logged ("system tray icon failed to start"), so a bad icon or backend no longer leaves a window that hides on close with nothing to bring it back. A new tray line in the log reads "system tray icon shown".
- Whiteboard: drag-selecting on the board no longer highlights text on other elements; the colour popup keeps its place when you switch between Fill and Border.
- Guide: its corner panel no longer covers the status-bar Guide button, and a second press on that button closes the panel (the press used to land on the card and do nothing).
- Needle is offered at most 15 tool schemas (the ones the question's words suggest, else the likeliest) instead of all 70: 30,359 to about 6,200 chars for a typical question, so each call reads a fifth of the text.
- With Ollama off, a refused connection is remembered for 5 s, so one chat turn makes one connect attempt instead of one per stage (probe, embed, filing, each ~2 s a refusal on Windows); the connect wait is 1 s (was 5), and re-evaluating a note with the model off logs one line, not a traceback.
- Lightbox: the 1:1 (Actual size) button shows pressed when the picture is already at actual size, as a picture smaller than the window is at fit; a press that changes nothing no longer looks broken (200x150: pressed at 100% before any press; 4000x3000: 20% to 100% and pressed).
- Whiteboard: turning a frame by its grip now turns everything wholly inside it about the frame's centre (each item's centre is carried round and its own rotation gains the same angle), in one Undo step; Ctrl turns the frame alone. The grip's tooltip says so.
- Chat, the Agent popup and Ask answer notes by the order made ("the first note I ever wrote", "my 5th note", "my 3rd most recent note") with the note linked and its date, or how many notes you have when the place is past the end; with no model they no longer say your notes don't mention "first" or answer with the tag table. Needle is now given only your request, and a call that puts a tool's name in a search is dropped (it had searched for "doesn't have count_notes").
- Ask and Chat: the "Grounded in" block is one collapsible fold (the heading is the toggle, open by default, remembered per browser); Chat now loads the same look as Ask. The number in each source badge is the bare digit, centred in its circle (0.01 px off, was 1.8 px with the trailing period).
- Use AI switch: draws its real state from the first status poll, not the 3 s preload (was drawn on for about 2.7 s over a model that was off, until clicked).
- Chat answers: a link with no words (`[](#/notes/85)`) shows the note's name, `[ ]` and `[x]` in prose are the app's disabled checkbox at text size, and a line of only the app's own links ("Open your notes") is a row of small ghost buttons.
- Notes from 600 to 820px wide: the "Your notes" sub-tab no longer sits under the sidebar's collapse toggle (the column keeps the rail clear; the tab starts at x 63 to 66, was 9.6 under a toggle ending at 51).
- Focus rings no longer cut off by their container: the Statistics body, the manual's contents jumps and topic links, the Settings nav's last button and the phone More button (0 px cut each, was 3.5 to 4.5).
- Statistics: a focused chart mark (a focusable SVG group) shows a 2px ring of its own, inside its slot.
- Label in name (WCAG 2.5.3): Capture's Add to document opener is named by its visible words, and the Dashboard's featured board button by its caption (title and count) rather than "Open the map ...".
- Settings > Data: a backup row's origin label ("Automatic daily backup") takes the ink instead of muted type on its tint (4.27:1 to above 4.5:1 in light).
- Phone: the Back and Forward history menu opens below the header instead of above the viewport (top -304 to 54 at 390).
- Notes list on a phone: a card whose facts are still too wide after folding to icons wraps to a second row instead of clipping its More actions button (li scrollWidth 418 to 358 at 390).
- Notes at 800px: the parked sidebar sheet no longer takes clicks over the first sub-tab; only its toggle does (elementFromPoint(54, 136) was the aside, now the sub-tab).
- Resurfacing: two requests scoring at once no longer 500 on UNIQUE note_scores.entry_id; new rows are upserted (GET /resurface/near/{id}).
- Security: a phrase filter in the Notes list ("tagged work", "pinned", "connected to") no longer returns private notes or boards; a private note's tags are stored in plain text, so the filter could name it.
- Agent popup: typing "/" shows the command menu again; it opened underneath the popup's overlay (z-index 60 against 2000), now above it like the other menus (INBOX 1333a).
- Chat, Agent popup and Guide: the From your notes, Composer and From the help badges are buttons that open a note on hover, click or Enter saying the answer was written without an AI model, how to tell it from a model's, and how to turn one on (INBOX 1344).
- Dashboard: the Notebook constellation rests after a while without input instead of drawing 60 frames a second on an idle Dashboard (600 frames and about 200ms of script per 10 seconds before), and wakes on the next pointer move, key, wheel or touch, its stars carrying on from where they stopped.
- Polling: the Library gallery stops looking while the window is hidden and waits longer after each look that found nothing new (6, 12, 24, 48, then 60 seconds; back to 6 on a change), and Settings no longer rebuilds the per-feature model rows on every three-second status answer, only when they change.
- Scrolling: Settings, Help scrolls with less script per wheel step (5.0-8.0ms to 4.0-5.2ms; its "On this page" marker 65-83ms to 11-14ms over 40 steps), and the Notes list runs 1.7-1.95ms of scroll listeners a step instead of 3.3-4.2ms: the section scroller is found once, the sidebar follow measures before it writes, and open toolbar menus are kept by their own toggle instead of searched for on every scroll.
- Atlas: asleep lying down, its Zs rise from its head (about 40px above the eyes in every pose) instead of from where a standing head would be.
- Timeline: the table view names a meeting "Meeting" in its Kind column (and in sort), and below 600px, where that column is hidden, the title starts with "Meeting: " (INBOX 341).
- Accessibility: eight worded buttons (Local chip default, From library, Jump to latest, Dock the tools, the map ring's Add child, Add beside, More and Reverse) and the Timeline day strip now start their accessible name with the words on them (WCAG 2.5.3; OPEN 1400).
- Header: the six right-hand buttons' keyboard ring no longer reaches past the window's top edge (offset 1px, ring top 0.5px; was -0.5px) (OPEN 408). The Library sub-tab rings were measured uncut.
- Notes and Dashboard: the notes grid and the phone quick-links strip no longer scroll 4px sideways; their ring room is padding only, with no negative right margin (OPEN 1435, 1278).
- Sidebar: the Categories collapse toggle sits on the head's row (8px lower, level with the filter button) while the collapsed sidebar is hover-opened.
- Statistics: the Ask box answers "when did I write my first note" (also oldest, newest, latest, when did I start) with the date and title, its field and Ask button share one 32px height, and a Clear button empties the answer and the box.
- Mind maps: a map too big to fit opens with its first topics at the top-left of the canvas instead of its root in the middle with the rest off the bottom-right, and each board remembers its own pan and zoom for the session (owner, 2026-10-19; INBOX 1340).
- Manual: Find anything and the palette have Open the manual (it can be a dashboard quick link), Settings, Help, The manual topic opens the manual itself, and the Guide's text names its More actions menu.
- Navigation: the manual and Statistics are places in the history list (Back closes them, the list names them), and the current row no longer shrinks when the list scrolls (INBOX 1335).
- Statistics: a failed open, range change or question offers Try again.
- Keyboard: the first Tab after the app loads or unlocks lands on "Skip to content" again, not the Local chip halfway along the top bar.
- Statistics: the Ask box reads "in July", "last month" and "in sept 2025" through the shared date reader, and a tile shows its hover look on keyboard focus too.
- Writing room: the Save as note button's dropdown half is the same colour as the button (INBOX 1337).
- Spelling: a word missing its apostrophe (whats, isnt, youre) offers the contraction first in the menu (INBOX 1343).
- Mind maps: no Format button; it had nothing to show for a topic (INBOX 1341).
- Whiteboard and maps: a left-drag on empty canvas draws the selection box, as before; the left-drag pan tried earlier in this release is reverted because it took the drag from the selection tools (INBOX 1332, WHITEBOARD_PLAN decision 41, MINDMAP_PLAN decision 48). Pan, Space, the middle and right buttons and two-finger scroll pan.
- Whiteboard: a click on a tinted panel's body or a plain frame's edge selects the frame, and a selected frame has a rotate handle like other objects; what lies inside does not turn (INBOX 1327).
- Whiteboard and maps: a two-finger trackpad scroll always pans (both axes) and a pinch or the mouse wheel zooms; the call is made once per gesture, so vertical-only frames no longer flip the board between panning and zooming (INBOX 1327).
- Whiteboard: pressing a selected connector's end grip moves that end instead of drawing a new arrow from the port beneath it (INBOX 1328).
- Search: the suggestions under a search box now also close when the page or results behind them scroll (INBOX 1330); Escape and a click outside already did.

- Suggestions: the Links list is redesigned: one bar with Link all above 70% and a menu holding Suggest reasons and Explain your existing links; each pair shows the two note names on one line each (cut, whole on hover), how sure and why on one line under them, and Add a reason, Link and dismiss together on the right (INBOX 1329).
- Dialogs: the title row no longer covers the top of a dialog's content when it opens; every sticky dialog head pinned 16px low (Suggestions, Statistics, Settings, Features and the rest) (INBOX 1329, part).
- Boards and maps: deleting a board for good finds its thumbnail from the uploads folder, so the notes layer no longer imports the API layer (CodeQL cyclic import).
- CI fixes: "what is due this week" lists waiting reminders again (only a question that says reminders is cut to its window), the answer chip has its keyboard focus style, the board Format panel menu row and command table share their words, and five functions plus the chat, board and task state were split or folded to meet the complexity and global-scope ratchets.
- Launcher: the starting splash has minimise and close buttons in its top right corner; close cancels the launch (INBOX 1320).
- Boards and maps: previews are now a real snapshot of the board, a 480px WebP (about 2 to 3 KB on the test boards) taken when edits settle or you leave the board, stored as a file, cached by the browser and used by the Library, Dashboard and chat cards; the drawn preview stays as the fallback (INBOX 1317).
- Chat: the box stays open while an answer streams; Enter queues the message above the box, with Edit (back into the box) and Remove, and the queue sends in order as each answer ends; Stop holds it (INBOX 1321).
- Statistics: the page is wider and taller, and only its body scrolls, so the title and close stay in view (INBOX 1319, part).
- Statistics: the charts answer the pointer and the keyboard: hover or focus a point or bar for the period and exact value, arrow keys move between them, a click or Enter opens it (a month opens the Timeline there, a feature bar opens that feature), and they redraw at the card's width (INBOX 1319, part).
- Statistics: the counts open what they count (notes, tags, links, documents, loose ends, reminders by state), the growth chart has a range of 3 months, a year or since the first note, and each week row has a small line of this week's days against last week's (INBOX 1319, part).
- Statistics: Ask about your statistics, a box at the top with three starters, answers from the counts with no model (a count in a named month, what you use most, whether this month or week is busier than the last, a summary of the month or week, and the chat's notebook questions) (INBOX 1319, part).
- Composer, no model (INBOX 1324, 1315): Ask answers a find with the matching notes instead of sending it to Chat; "how many notes do I have about work" gives the figure; "list my recipes" lists the tag; "last week" and "next month" no longer drop or empty a subject; "knives" finds "Knife sharpening"; "delete everything" is answered with the safe way; reminders asked for "this week" are that week's, without a false Heads up; the Guide answers "can I use this offline" and "what does Atlas do"; compare questions name Porto and Lisbon as typed and a heading is named without its hash. 40-question grade: 23 to 32 fully good (scratchpad/composer1324-grades.md).
- Dashboard: the Ask AI quick link is now Ask your notes, since it answers from your notes with or without a model running.

- Phone: the bottom bar reads Dashboard, Notes, Chat, Library, More, with More last (it drew first); More's sheet lists Graph, Timeline and Reminders, a rule, then the tools; the header's menu is the App menu; pressing the tab you are on goes to the top of its page; a reminder's +1h and the timeline's days at 360 meet 44 px (INBOX 1314).
- Whiteboard: Ctrl+Enter while typing in a sticky starts the next one beside it, same paper and size (INBOX 1308).
- Whiteboard: a C4 and architecture set in the library (person, software system, external system, container, database, component, boundary, relationship); each places as one group (INBOX 1308).

Every Matching records entry carries a reason in words ("Matches hobbies by meaning, and shares #gaming with the gaming mouse"). Grammar: no "one weeks", a title is "you saved your Gym Routine Overview", a repeated schedule is "a Pull, Push, Legs split with rest days", "Your League of Legends note says ...", and a day in the last week is "a week ago", "last Friday" or "yesterday".

## [0.6.0] - 2026-10-18
- Answers: dated lines no longer open the same way twice: the gap lead ("after three weeks", "three weeks later") turns line by line and never repeats within an answer (INBOX 1301 D5).
- Answers: a day's note that does not open in "you" is dated in a clause ("On 9 August, at Mia's barbecue ..."), never a "**9 August:**" label line (INBOX 1301 D5).
- Composer overview: a heading's first word is a thread only when it is a topic, so an ordinary word like "Ask" no longer reads as one ("Ask features in two of them") (INBOX 1301 D5).

- Undo and Redo run one at a time: Ctrl+Shift+Z pressed while Ctrl+Z was still settling found nothing to redo and left the note deleted. Ctrl+K lists only notes that contain every word typed, and drops the guessed Close in meaning commands when one matches.
- Companion: a throw that splats on a side and slides onto a ledge now stands on that ledge (stepping along it past a control) instead of jumping 235px up to hang from the top bar (UX fix 2; the cause was the landing search's 48px reach, not an idle timer).
- Dashboard hero on a phone: the greeting holds two lines, so saving a name no longer grows the hero 82 to 118px and pushes the page down 36px (UX fix 1).
- Settings on a phone: the pane heading is hidden when the section list above it already shows the same name (Models over Models) (UX audit 9).
- No-model notice: its action reads in ink on a phone, 4.5 or better in dark (was the accent at 3.96:1) (UX audit 2).
- Suggested tags: the take target has a 28px press area (a band behind the 14px words), without growing the chip (UX audit 6).
- Dashboard: the headline no longer repeats the sub line's count ("Already 12 notes today" is now "A full page today"), and an untitled newest note no longer reads "the latest your note from today" (UX audit 4).
- Sweeps: `THEME=dark` now sets the theme through the app once unlocked (the saved preference used to win, so every dark sweep measured light); a mismatch prints BOOT-WARN (UX audit 1).
- File viewer (the lightbox): a top bar names the file, says where you are (2 of 5) and holds its actions (Copy text, Download, Open in a new tab, Details, a help popover, the ⋯, Close); a floating dock at the foot holds the view (zoom out and in, Fit, 1:1 actual size, Rotate, a PDF's pages) with a filmstrip above it for more than one file. Scroll zooms smoothly about the pointer, double-click switches between fit and actual size, keys + - 0 1 R I work, swipe and pinch work on a phone, and the bars fade while the mouse rests on the picture (never for the keyboard or reduced motion). On a phone the picture is 359px wide instead of 233. A picture paged to from a PDF now zooms itself rather than the PDF.
- Phone: the tab bar's More shows the reminders due count (and the Reminders row inside the sheet), since Reminders sits behind it at 390; the agent run count shows when none are due.
- Notifications: the bell badge no longer counts the app's own job lines (backup, housekeeping, reading dates); a first run showed 5, now 1. A failed job still counts and every line is still listed.
- Ctrl+K: typing a note's name offers its top three matching notes under the commands (Enter opens it), and the palette takes focus before it draws the catalogue: focus 41 ms to 4 ms and rows 81 ms to 26 ms (median of 5 at 1440).
- Boards: the picker no longer keeps a "Default board" row while the list says No boards yet and the chips read All 0, Maps 0, Boards 0.
- A new empty mind map shows one empty state, the card with the Add the first topic button; the template strip waits for the root. The card's copy no longer says "again".
- Companion: a throw has chances on the way. It may catch the top bar and hang from it, catch a panel's top edge and climb on, splat against a side and slide down to the panel below, or go off one side and come back on the other; once down it settles by sitting with its legs dangling or kicking, lying down, stretching or swinging. It always ends over no control; Reduce motion keeps the plain crossfade (INBOX 1301 D6).
